# How many World Series have the Astros won? History of Houston's Fall Classic appearances

Kevin Skiver

•
[Add Sporting News on Google](https://google.com/preferences/source?q=sportingnews.com)

For the seventh year in a row, the Houston Astros are in the ALCS. They're looking to punch a ticket to their fifth World Series in those seven years, and their third straight.

Indeed, what the Astros are doing right now is special. They only trail the 1991-1999 Braves in consecutive LCS appearances (that team made it eight times, a streak that was interrupted only by the 1994 strike). They have two World Series titles to their name, and they've made it four total times during this run.

The name of the game for these Astros? Continuity.

Despite firing A.J. Hinch after the 2017 cheating scandal was uncovered, Dusty Baker has retained several of the mainstay players of this run. Jose Altuve, Alex Bregman, Justin Verlander, and Ryan Pressly are just some of the longtime players still on this roster, and they're looking to add to the Astros' trophy case.
Standing in their way is the Rangers and the winner of Phillies vs. Diamondbacks. Can the Astros win another title? Here's a glimpse at their history as they try to make a run.

## Have the Astros won the World Series?

The Astros have won two World Series, but their first was fraught with controversy.

Houston won the 2017 World Series over the Dodgers, a title that has been roundly criticized because of the pitch stealing operation that has been uncovered since. As a result of the scandal, which involved banging on trash cans to tip off pitches, manager A.J. Hinch was fired from the team after being suspended for a year while general manager Jeff Luhnow was also suspended for a season.

The Astros beat the Dodgers in seven games, and George Springer (now with the Blue Jays) was named World Series MVP. Jose Altuve won the 2017 MVP award for the regular season.

They next played the Nationals and the Braves in World Series, but lost both those appearances.
Back in 2022, however, the Astros made it back to the World Series and beat the Phillies in six games, claiming their first title since that controversial 2017 victory. A potential rematch between the two teams is on the table if the Astros win in the ALCS and the Phillies beat Arizona.

## When is the last time the Astros made the World Series?

The Astros are the defending AL pennant winners, having made it last season against the Phillies.

The Phillies made a wild run to the World Series in 2022, defeating the Cardinals in the wild-card series, the Braves in the NLDS and the Padres in the NLCS.

Houston also made it in 2019 and 2021, where they lost to two NL East teams: the Nationals and the Braves, respectively. Washington won the Dusty Bowl a year before Baker came to manage the Astros.

## Astros World Series appearances

The Astros have made five World Series appearances, and are 2-3 in those appearances.
Their wins are in 2017 and 2022, and they have losses in 2005 (as a National League team), 2019, and 2021.
